findings.message: End-of-life date 2026-12-01 is approximately 1.5 months from review date (2026-10-16), within the 3-month cap but without an accepted human support plan in CODEOWNERS. Per §2 Release policy, upstream-sourced rocks require a support plan for EOL dates beyond today + 3 months. No such plan is documented. Request a support plan or adjust the end-of-life date.

summary: Source bump from commit 000000000000000000000000000000000a to 000000000000000000000000000000000b with intentional removal of build-marker nil part. Recipe regression gate passes; deb-manifest gate passes. EOL cap gate fails due to lack of documented support plan.
